items.q: Maman quotes a lonely friend who has nothing to do all day. A Persian saying kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: A lokacin dariya, Hooman ya buga bayana da hannunsa da ƙarfi, sai gurasar suga ta yi tsalle ta shiga maƙogwarona.
items.q: Hooman thumps Amir on the back while he drinks tea. A Persian image kept word for word: can you guess what happens?

items.text: Kar ka faɗa wa wannan Eskandar mai wahala, zai sake zaunar da mu awa ɗaya yana mana wa'azi, abincin ya zama dafin maciji a gare ni.
items.q: A student got a big portion of rice and fears a friend's lecture. A Persian expression kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Sai bayan iyalina sun tura ni cikin kaji ne na fahimci wace duniya ce ta daban a wancan ɓangaren labarin.
items.q: A friend talks about his own life after his family pushed him. A Persian expression kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: A cikin gidan a ƙarshen fili, kusa da murhu, ina kwance a cikina na kasance a tsakiyar nema don hanyar warware tambayoyin Konkur na lissafin triangles da sauki ta amfani da da'irar trigonometry.
items.q: Is 'murhu' right for a room heater used to keep warm?
before: – To kawai saboda tsawon jiran da na yi, zauna kusa da ni ɗan lokaci kuma.

…amma zuciyata tana ƙonewa. Har yanzu tana ƙonewa. Ƙonewar tuna wannan lokacin ban da sai. Kuma watakila ƙonewar mantuwa da wani abu wanda nake jin bai kamata in manta da shi ba. Wani abu kamar rashin nutsuwa – rashin nutsuwa mai tsayawa a bayan hazo. Ah, mantawa; ah, manta; ah, a manta da mutum.

items.text: Wani lokaci, idan Sajad ya yi kuskuren ɗauka wuyan Farid a matsayin matattara yayin hawa gadonsa, Farid yakan zo ya kwana a gadon Bahman.
items.q: Is 'matattara' right for a foothold, a place to step while climbing?
before: – A'a, bai ma amsa mini ba.

'Yan kwanaki bayan haka, ya amsa mana duka tare. Ya rubuta cewa an mayar da shi zuwa masaukin masu aure kuma ya bar ɗakinmu. Meysam ya ce a can a ƙasa ya fi jin daɗi, gadon Bahman kuwa ya rage babu kowa.

items.text: Farid ya ɗauki matashinsa da mayafinsa ya zo ya kwanta a samanin gadon da ke sama da tawa — gado wanda Bahman ya kwanta a kai a cikin sassan farko biyu na jami'a, kuma har wannan dare ya kusan shekaru uku da yanayin jikin Bahman ya bar matacciyar a kan gado.
items.q: Is it clear the mattress had long forgotten the warmth of Bahman's body?
before: – Ina a wuyata a rubuce cewa fiye da matakin ƙafa?
– A zahiri, na tafi birkita hakorana na wanke hannuwana da fuskata ma. Ba ni da tabarau; ban gani ba.

items.text: Ni da Yaser da Taghi da Hamid mun zauna a kan bene kusa da titi mai girma muna jira mu ga wane tumatir ne, kafin sauran, da za a murɗe a ƙarƙashin guduwar motatoce.
items.q: Is 'bene' the right word for the curb at the roadside?
before: Sun yin mini dariya. Bayan haka, na riƙa ƙidaya tumatirin na, kuma kowace lokaci Maman ta ce in sayi tumatiri, na ciro wannan lambar daga jakar filastin na, ba tare da Baba Badiollah ya gani ba, na jefa su cikin akwatin tumatir nasa.

items.text: Yana cewa, an kashe ni da yakin sinadarai; komai ba zai gyara ni ba.
items.q: Baba was gassed in the war but survived. Is 'an kashe ni' right here?
before: – Saboda haka yana da kyau cewa ba ya kusa da ke sosai.

…don kada ka yi kokht-kokht haka. Yana cewa, ba zan sha ba; kuna son sanya mini guba. Sau ɗaya jijiyoyina sun ɓaci, 'ya'yan ba su nan. Sa'ad da 'ya'ya suna nan, ba ya ƙarfin faɗa da ni. Na ce, idan ba za ka saurare mu ba, ka tafi likita da kanka. Ya ce, kar ki yi magana, ko in buge ki ki lalace.
